newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet prices and differentials to gas oil stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet prices and differentials to gas oil stable.

text.p: European jet fuel prices were steady in quiet trade with prices moving in line with benchmark gas oil futures as barge and cargo premiums held stable though physical activity remained dull, traders said.
Barges were assessed around August IPE +$16/18 a tonne fob ARA following trade on Wednesday at +$17 fob Rotterdam. Cargoes talked August IPE +$17/+$19 a tonne cif NWE.
While trade in NWE stayed thin, high freight costs and firm sellers' levels also stifled Med demand.
In the Med most refiners had only small jet parcels to offer and buyers took fright at current high freight rates. Brokers said putting together combination cargoes was proving very difficult.
Larger cargoes were on offer but at a price. Algerian and Greek sellers were holding off in the double figures. Internal Greek demand saw deals done at quotes high +$10-12 a tonne.
